audit.whatIsWrong: Every phase reason is shared template text. Level 1 claims 'Q-poke on energy rhythm wins the chip war' on a stage the chart gives to Dr. Mundo.
audit.why: Infected Bonesaw reaches 975 against your 550 Q and only costs him health, so you lose the level-1 poke war outright.
audit.corrected: Phase reasons rewritten around Infected Bonesaw's range, Heart Zapper's sustain, Blunt Force Trauma's auto reset and Maximum Dosage.

audit.whatIsWrong: The first-item spike was tied to 'Heart Zapper's cooldown' and never mentioned that Akali's real spike here is item plus anti-heal.
audit.why: Against a champion whose W and R are both healing, Lich Bane alone does not open a kill window — Oblivion Orb does.
audit.corrected: phases[5].why now pairs the first item with anti-heal; phases[6].why states that his health stacking outgrows single-target burst.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two interactions were absent: Blunt Force Trauma is an auto-attack reset, and Twilight Shroud does not stop Infected Bonesaw.
audit.why: The kit file flags Blunt Force Trauma (E) autoReset. Twilight Shroud makes Akali 'unable to be selected by enemy spells and attacks' — a ground-targeted skillshot like Bonesaw selects nothing, so it still travels through the smoke.
audit.corrected: The auto reset is stated in phases[3].why and dontsFull[1].d; the Shroud limit in phases[1].why and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Track Heart Zapper' repeated throughout with no number attached.
audit.why: Heart Zapper is 17/16.5/16/15.5/15, Infected Bonesaw a flat 4s, Blunt Force Trauma 9s at rank 1, Maximum Dosage 120s at every rank.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to winCon, phases[3], phases[4] and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull and dontsFull descriptions did not match their titles — 'Forget anti-heal' was described as diving without shroud or energy.
audit.corrected: Each description rewritten to explain its own title.

edits.before: Anti-heal and execute him. Track Heart Zapper before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Anti-heal and execute him. Heart Zapper is 17s at rank 1 — do your killing inside that gap.

edits.before: Q-poke on energy rhythm wins the chip war. Identify how Dr. Mundo contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Infected Bonesaw reaches 975 against your 550 kunai and costs him only health — you lose the level 1 poke war, so just farm.

edits.before: Shroud rewrites any trade he starts. Only take the trade when Dr. Mundo's Heart Zapper is down.
edits.after: Shroud breaks his targeting, not his cleaver — Infected Bonesaw still lands through the smoke.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Dr. Mundo must walk into your range.
edits.after: Full kit online, but he out-sustains chip: Heart Zapper heals back what your poke takes, so trade in bursts, never in chip.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Heart Zapper's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: The lane-control window: Blunt Force Trauma (9s) is an auto reset, so his wind-up — not the cast — is the cue to step out of range.

edits.before: Both R casts turn survived all-ins into executes. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Dr. Mundo's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Both R casts execute, but Maximum Dosage (120s) hands him back a huge slab of health — apply Grievous Wounds, then commit.

edits.before: Lich Bane is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Heart Zapper's cooldown.
edits.after: Lich Bane plus early anti-heal is your spike — force the fight the moment both land.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Dr. Mundo carry threat 8/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on, but his health stacking outgrows single-target burst — win it before the game becomes an HP contest.

edits.before: - Dr. Mundo Heart Zapper: matchup-defining — His sustain + reset. Anti-heal it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Heart Zapper (17s at rank 1): his sustain and reset — anti-heal it. - Infected Bonesaw: 4s, costs his own health, and Shroud does not stop it. - Maximum Dosage (120s): the heal that undoes a whole rotation.

edits.before: Q Dr. Mundo at max blade range, E-dash the angle when his answer is down, and shroud the return fire.
edits.after: Q him at 550 while Heart Zapper is down, E-mark and dash the angle, then Shroud his empowered auto.

edits.before: Diving with no shroud and no energy — Akali without resources is a melee mage with paper armor.
edits.after: Trading through Heart Zapper without any Grievous Wounds — he just drinks the damage back.

edits.before: Q Dr. Mundo at max blade range, E-dash the angle when his answer is down, and shroud the return fire.
edits.after: Oblivion Orb before your second item — Heart Zapper and his R heal back more than you poke.

edits.before: Dr. Mundo wastes Heart Zapper — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Five Point Strike reaches 550 — chip him while Heart Zapper is down.

edits.before: That is Dr. Mundo's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Extended trades are where Heart Zapper pays him back — burst him, then leave.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Bonesaw is on 4s and Shroud will not blank it — sidestep instead.

edits.before: Diving with no shroud and no energy — Akali without resources is a melee mage with paper armor.
edits.after: Without Grievous Wounds his Heart Zapper and Maximum Dosage erase your whole rotation.

edits.before: Track Dr. Mundo's Heart Zapper: His sustain + reset. Anti-heal it. When it is down — E-Q + R him.
edits.after: Heart Zapper (17s) is his sustain and reset — anti-heal it. Shroud does not blank his cleaver.

notes: The _missing file lists 'Dr. Mundo bypasses stacking resistances (Maximum Dosage (R))' — reading the kit description, Maximum Dosage is a heal plus max-health and regen boost, not a resistance-bypass effect. I treated it as a healing problem (Grievous Wounds) rather than repeating the resistance framing, per the rule that Riot's description beats a derived flag. His passive Goes Where He Pleases is flagged hardCC; Akali brings no immobilizing CC, so it does not apply in this matchup and I wrote nothing about it.
